stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_check_caller: project admin cancels sale
    q_check_caller --> q_check_not_published: caller is projectAdmin
    q_check_caller --> q_revert_auth: unauthorized
    q_check_not_published --> q_check_not_canceled: results not yet published
    q_check_not_published --> q_revert_published: cannot cancel after results published
    q_check_not_canceled --> q_cancel: sale not already canceled
    q_check_not_canceled --> q_revert_canceled: already canceled
    q_cancel --> [*]: isCanceled = true, emit SaleCanceled()
    q_revert_auth --> [*]: revert Unauthorized
    q_revert_published --> [*]: revert ResultsAlreadyPublished
    q_revert_canceled --> [*]: revert AlreadyCanceled

    note right of q_check_not_published
        INV-001: Cancellation only allowed before results publication
        INV-002: After cancellation, investors can withdraw via withdrawInvestedCapitalIfCanceled
    end note
